_note: Owner-editable enforcement limits read by icarus_run.py (looser = raise numbers, tighter = lower). Defaults apply if a key is missing. Hard stops end the run with FAIL and a receipt; they are never silently retried. Reads are repo-wide except denyPathPrefixes. write_file/delete_file need an OWNER_APPROVED: line and never touch writeDenyPathPrefixes (the governor files stay owner-only). Owner pings (not the hourly schedule) run discover -> decide -> act; add a line 'LOOP: off' to skip it. delegate opens a REQUESTED Teamchat task issue for a chair and wakes via PR #8; it is never proof the chair did anything.
